# Brief

Local test build for SpiderCaster, the copy-driven website engine
(V:\a\ai\spidercaster\working). Audience: Keith and the free-model seats. The page documents
what the engine does, the token rules it runs on, and its commands. Tone:
plain, factual, no marketing fluff. This build stays noindex.

data.headline: SpiderCaster: websites from real copy, on free tokens
data.subhead: SpiderCaster is a copy-driven static website engine. You give it a brief and real copy files; it returns a self-contained static site. The structure, layout, styling and assembly are deterministic code, so the bulk of every build costs zero tokens. AI is optional and rides the free chain: the Gemini free tier first, then OpenRouter free models, then OpenWork inference. Paid models join only when explicitly allowed.

body: The engine follows the WebDev package rails: it never invents facts, prices or claims; output stays noindex until approved; secrets are read from environment variable names only; and every run writes a token ledger so the cost is auditable.

items.title: forge init PROJECT
items.body: scaffold a project with brief.md and a copy folder.

items.title: forge build PROJECT --offline
items.body: zero-token build mapped from your copy.

items.title: forge build PROJECT
items.body: AI build on the free chain, with offline fallback.

items.title: forge build --from SITE/site.json
items.body: rebuild after hand edits, zero tokens.

items.q: Does the offline build really cost zero tokens?
items.a: Yes. The offline planner maps your copy files into sections with deterministic rules, and the renderer assembles the HTML from code. No model is called.

items.q: What does an AI build cost?
items.a: One planning call, plus at most one repair retry if the reply is not valid JSON. On the Gemini free tier the estimated cost is zero dollars; the ledger in report.json records the exact token counts.
No. The planning prompt restricts the model to facts and wording present in your source copy. It may reorganize and tighten, but it may not invent facts, prices, names or claims.

items.q: How do I change something without tokens?
items.a: Edit sites/NAME/site.json by hand and rebuild with forge build --from. The renderer is deterministic, so the rebuild is free.

items.q: How does this fit the fleet checks?
items.a: The built-in forge check mirrors the fleet content markers, the hotlink blocklist and the noindex rail, so a site that passes forge check is aligned with website_checker content rules before any deploy conversation starts.
